The clips in this folder are synthetic speech made by gen.py with the Piper
en_US-libritts_r-medium voice (sherpa-onnx release tts-models, int8 build).
The voice was trained on LibriTTS-R (https://www.openslr.org/141/), which is
licensed Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY-4.0),
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

LibriTTS-R: Y. Koizumi et al., "LibriTTS-R: A Restored Multi-Speaker
Text-to-Speech Corpus", Interspeech 2023. The clips contain no real
recordings of any person.
